## Documentation

* 	[Swagger UI](http://localhost:8080/swagger-ui.html) - `http://localhost:8080/swagger-ui.html` - interactive API documentation and testing, generated by [springdoc-openapi](https://springdoc.org/). Use **Authorize** to paste an access token from `/api/v1/auth/login`.
* 	[OpenAPI 3 document](http://localhost:8080/v3/api-docs) - `http://localhost:8080/v3/api-docs` - machine readable description of the API, for client generators and tools such as Postman or Insomnia.
* 	Both are available in every profile except `production`, where they are switched off (`springdoc.api-docs.enabled` and `springdoc.swagger-ui.enabled`).
* 	[Postman Collection](https://documenter.getpostman.com/view/2449187/TVCe1UAk) - online, with code snippets generated in cURL, jQuery, Ruby, Python Requests, Node, PHP and Go.
* 	Postman Collection for offline testing: `documents/Spring Boot Application Template.postman_collection.json`.
* 	Javadoc is generated in `target/reports/apidocs` with:

```shell
./mvnw javadoc:javadoc
```
